headline: 4 addresses catalogued on Ethereum from block-explorer search and docs; vesperfi/metadata JSON (controllers+pools+tokens registry) discovered but not fetched; multi-chain surface (Base, Optimism, Avalanche, Polygon) unresolved.

findings.text: Etherscan name-tag search surfaced: VSP governance token at 0x1b40183EFB4Dd766f11bDa7A7c3AD8982e998421 (labelled 'Vesper Finance: Vesper Token'), deployer EOA at 0xb5abdabe50b5193d4db92a16011792b22ba3ef51 (labelled 'Vesper Finance: Deployer'), and vWBTC pool token at 0x4b2e76ebbc9f2923d83f5fbde695d8733db1a17b. A second deployer-origin address 0x59543a595b69897b295f12964d3c7c37b3ad29c0 also appeared with 'Vesper Finance: Deployer' tag.

Docs site is at docs.vesper.finance. No single canonical 'Deployed contracts' page with all addresses was found; multi-chain deployment page exists but contains no addresses. The vesperfi/metadata GitHub repo is described as the authoritative source of deployment addresses (src/vesper-metadata.json with controllers, pools, and tokens sections), but the JSON file itself was not fetchable in this run.

Audit link https://github.com/vesperfi/doc/tree/main/audit was blocked (permission denied). Security page at vesper.finance/security confirms audits by Halborn, Dedaub, Certik, and Quantstamp, described as '50+ audits'. No in-scope contract addresses could be extracted from audit PDFs this run.

GitHub org vesperfi confirmed active. Repo vesperfi/metadata identified as canonical deployment artifact store containing src/vesper-metadata.json (controllers: Controller + Collateral Manager; pools: all past and present pool contracts; tokens: VSP token). Repo vesperfi/vesper-pools confirmed as smart contract source with hardhat-deploy pattern. JSON artifact could not be fetched (URL not in allowlist this run).

Protocol confirmed deployed on Ethereum, Base, Optimism, Avalanche, and Polygon per docs and website. Vesper docs state contracts on L2s are 'very similar, if not identical, to those deployed to Ethereum'. Zero chain-specific addresses were retrieved for Base, Optimism, Avalanche, or Polygon in this run — those chains are unresolved.

No factory contract address was found. The metadata repo structure (controllers section) suggests a Controller contract likely manages pool deployment, but no factory address was read on-chain this run.

Role taxonomy applied: VSP token (token), deployer EOA (other/deployer), vWBTC pool (pool), second deployer address (other/deployer). Controller and Collateral Manager mentioned in metadata repo as main control contracts but addresses not retrieved.

All four addresses in admin_addresses trace to Etherscan search result URLs fetched/observed in this run. The vesperfi/metadata JSON addresses were not fetched and are excluded from admin_addresses pending a future run.

rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked vesper.finance, docs.vesper.finance, vesper.finance/security, github.com/vesperfi/metadata, and Etherscan name-tag search results. 4 Ethereum addresses catalogued with on-chain citation; the canonical deployment registry (vesperfi/metadata src/vesper-metadata.json with Controller, Collateral Manager, and all pool addresses) was identified but not fetched — this is the primary gap. Multi-chain surface (Base, Optimism, Avalanche, Polygon) is entirely unresolved. Grade is unknown because address discovery is incomplete.

protocol_metadata.about: Vesper Finance is a multi-chain yield aggregator that lets users deposit crypto assets (ETH, WBTC, USDC, and others) into 'Grow Pools,' which automatically route capital to other DeFi protocols to earn yield. Harvested yield is used to buy back more of the deposit asset, compounding returns for pool participants. The VSP token governs the ecosystem; holders can lock VSP for esVSP to receive a share of protocol revenue distributed via buybacks. Vesper is deployed on Ethereum, Base, Optimism, Avalanche, and Polygon, with the same core smart contract architecture across chains.
